page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is a high clock speed virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 architecture. The instance delivers 64 dedicated vCPUs sourced from an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 3.1 GHz. System memory totals 256.0 GB, producing a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware configurations for this server do not include local disk storage, meaning persistent data storage relies on external network-attached block storage devices. There are no GPU accelerators present on the instance. Network throughput is provisioned with a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth capacity, and the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default.

With its 64 dedicated processor cores operating at an elevated clock speed, the server delivers high compute density without CPU overcommit risks. The hardware profile aligns efficiently with CPU-sensitive applications requiring balanced memory, such as enterprise relational databases, CI/CD compilation workloads, backend web application clusters, and batch data processing.
